_comment: Figures copied by hand out of published reports, for the things no API serves.
Every row MUST carry `source_url` and `as_of` or it is rejected at load time —
see services/ownership/providers/manual.py. A hand-typed number with no filing
behind it cannot be told apart from an invented one, and this page's entire
claim is that each figure is checkable.
`group` is what an entity points at via sources.manual.group in
ownership_entities.json. Several rows may share a group.
Rows retire themselves: past 18 months they are shown with a 'Last reported'
note, past 36 months they stop being served and the cell reverts to Unknown.
